item.title: MemArena Benchmark Tests On-Device Agent Memory Across 50 Agents and 10.3M Tokens
item.summary: MemArena, a new benchmark simulating 50 agents over 15 days with 10.3M tokens, finds that memory-backend architecture yields roughly 3× the accuracy gains of model scaling for on-device personal memory assistants, while exposing universal failures in permission-aware information access.
